impacts.statement: Extensive flooding along the river. Dozens of structures isolated or flooded. Significant flooding of Singleton AVE,Scriven ST,Virginia ST,Woodland DR,Cedar LN,Dutch Neck RD,McFarlin ST and Main ST between the railroad and Gordon ST. Kingstree Train Station floods. The end of Mill ST,areas along Nathan RD,Ashton ST,N Brooks ST,and HWY 52 at the river flood. Millwood RD,Thorntree RD, and Council RD impassable. Nelson BLVD,W Academy ST,Sandy Bay RD flood. Reed ST may flood. Wastewater treatment plant flooded.

Extensive flooding along the river. Dozens of structures isolated or flooded. Significant flooding of Singleton AVE,Scriven ST,Virginia ST,Cedar LN,Dutch Neck RD,McFarlin ST,and Main ST between the railroad and Gordon ST. The Kingstree Train Station may flood. The end of Mill ST,areas along Nathan RD,Woodland DR,Ashton ST,N Brooks ST,and HWY 52 at the river flooded. Millwood RD,Thorntree RD,and Council RD impassable. Nelson BLVD,W Academy ST and Sandy Bay RD may flood. Wastewater treatment plant floods.

Extensive flooding along the river. Dozens of structures isolated or flooded. Significant flooding many areas including Singleton AVE, Scriven ST, Virginia ST, Cedar LN, Dutch Neck RD, and McFarlin ST. The end of Mill ST and areas along Nathan RD flooded. Main ST flooded between the railroad and Gordon ST with water several feet deep near the canal. Ashton ST and N Brooks ST flooded. Wastewater treatment plant flooding worsens. Woodland DR, Thorntree RD, Council RD and Millwood RD will flood.

Extensive flooding along the river. Dozens of structures isolated or flooded. Flooding worsens in many areas including Singleton AVE, Scriven ST, Virginia ST, Cedar LN, and McFarlin ST. The end of Mill ST and areas along Nathan RD flooded. Areas from Dutch Neck RD and McFarlin ST inaccessible. Dutch Neck RD flooded at Main ST. East of the railroad Main ST and Ashton AVE flood. Wastewater treatment plant flooding worsens. Areas along Woodland DR, Thorntree RD,and Council RD will flood. Millwood RD may flood.

Extensive flooding along the river. Dozens of structures isolated or flooded. Singleton AVE flooding along Scriven and Virginia ST and flooding along Cedar LN and McFarlin ST worsens. The end of Mill ST and areas along Nathan RD flooded. Areas from Dutch Neck Rd to McFarlin ST inaccessible. Dutch Neck RD flooded at Main ST. Flooding along the railroad affects Main ST and Ashton AVE. Low areas at the wastewater treatment plant flood. Areas along Woodland DR, Thorntree RD, and Council Rd may flood.

Extensive flooding along the river. Dozens of structures may be isolated or impacted by flooding. Singleton AVE flooding will worsen along Scriven and Virginia ST. Areas near the end of Mill ST and along Nathan RD will flood. Flooding along Cedar LN and McFarlin ST worsens. Gilland Memorial Park and areas from Dutch Neck RD to McFarlin ST inaccessible. Dutch Neck RD floods at Main ST. Flooding E of the railroad affects Main ST and may get into structures. Low areas near the wastewater treatment plant flood.

Extensive flooding will occur along the river. Several structures may be isolated or impacted by flooding. Singleton AVE flooding will worsen along Scriven ST and Virginia ST and gets into buildings along Scriven ST. Areas near the end of Mill ST and along Nathan RD will flood. Flooding along Cedar Lane and McFarlin ST worsens. Gilland Memorial Park and low areas between Dutch Neck Rd and McFarlin ST inaccessible. Dutch Neck RD impassable near Main ST. Flooding east of the railroad spreads north of Main ST.

Extensive flooding along the river and tributaries. Many structures may be isolated or impacted by flooding. Singleton AVE flooding will reach Scriven ST and yards along Virginia ST and get into buildings along Scriven ST. The end of Mill ST floods. Areas along Cedar Lane and McFarlin ST flood. Gilland Memorial Park and low areas from Dutch Neck RD to McFarlin ST inaccessible. Dutch Neck RD impassable near Main ST. Flooding of low areas along Nathan RD and east of the railroad south of Main ST worsens.

Singleton AVE flooding will reach yards along Scriven ST and Virginia ST and may get into buildings along Scriven ST. Gilland Memorial Park may be inaccessible. The end of Mill ST floods. Low areas from Dutch Neck RD to McFarlin ST inaccessible. Areas on the river side of Cedar Lane from McFarlin ST to S Longstreet ST will flood. Dutch Neck RD may be impassable near Main ST. Low areas along Nathan Rd and east of the railroad south of Main ST flood. Structures in low-lying areas may be isolated by flooding.

Flood waters will continue to affect immediate areas along the river.  Low areas along Nathan Road will be flooded.  Singleton AVE flooding may reach yards along Scriven ST and Gilland Memorial Park may be inaccessible.  Low areas between Dutch Neck Rd and McFarlin ST may be inaccessible.  Dutch Neck RD will flood about one quarter mile from Main ST.  Areas of the river side of Cedar Lane flood from McFarlin ST to S Longstreet ST.  Several structures in low lying areas may be isolated by the floodwaters.

Flood waters will affect low lying areas along the river.  Lower parts of Singleton AVE including Gilland Memorial Park will be flooded.  Low areas between Dutch Neck Rd and McFarlin ST will flood. Dutch Neck RD may begin to flood about one-quarter mile from Main ST.
Flood waters will affect low lying areas along the river.  Lower parts of Singleton Avenue near Gilland Memorial Park may flood.  Low areas between Dutch Neck Rd and McFarlin ST will flood.
Low areas along the river may flood including some dirt access roads.

hydronotes.statement: River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 48 hours into the future from the forecast issuance time.
